verdict.rationale: Elastic documents native OpenTelemetry ingestion with vendor-neutral instrumentation and no proprietary agents. EDOT is described as having no vendor lock-in, which supports the instrument-once-with-open-standards half of the story. Backend portability is only implied by these vendor claims; no evidence shows OTel-instrumented code being moved to or from another backend without re-instrumentation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of switching backends without code changes, clarity on whether EDOT-specific features tie users to Elastic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: This allows organizations to use vendor-neutral instrumentation and stream native OTel data without proprietary agents, leveraging Elastic OpenTelemetry.
